summary: Publishes externally consumable shared and host packages without unresolved pnpm workspace protocol dependencies.
userImpact: EnterpriseGlue EE and other external package consumers can refresh lockfiles after an OSS release without pnpm treating @enterpriseglue/plugin-sdk as a missing local workspace package.

instructions: Package consumers should update @enterpriseglue/shared to 0.15.2, @enterpriseglue/backend-host to 0.13.3, and @enterpriseglue/frontend-host to 0.15.2 together.

security: The package payload is unchanged except for resolving internal workspace dependency declarations to immutable published versions.
documentation: The generated release notes describe the corrected public package dependency contract and coordinated package versions.
rollback: Consumers can restore their previous lockfile and package versions; no database or configuration rollback is required.
validation: CI packs every public package and rejects workspace protocol dependencies in the external manifest.
A clean external-consumer install validates the packed shared and host package set.
EnterpriseGlue EE package sync refreshes lockfiles and runs plugin API compatibility, typecheck, and unit tests.
